title: presentation.summaries of "none" suppresses summary annotations
rationale: An engine that ignores presentation preferences and always summarises fails here. This is the cheapest available probe of "honour the manifest you were given" that does not depend on model-tier richness.

requirement.text: rule-based — MUST honor source trust and distrust weighting, presentation preferences, and provenance surfacing that is detectable without a model.

content.title: School districts weigh where student data lives

blocks.text: The district is piloting local-first software that keeps student records on classroom machines rather than in a vendor cloud.
An internal review found that 73 percent of teacher laptops were missing critical updates at the start of the school year.
A state audit published in 2024 found gaps in vendor contracts, with 40 districts affected according to the published report.
